FAQ.Title: Common Questions About What an AI
FAQ.Description: Find answers to the most frequent questions about our AI image and video generator. Learn how to get started today.

Items.Question: What is What an AI?
Items.Answer: What an AI is an all-in-one creative platform. It allows you to generate images, create videos, and apply visual effects using advanced artificial intelligence, all without needing design skills.

Items.Question: Is there a free AI tool for beginners?
Items.Answer: Yes, What an AI offers a free tier for new users. You can start generating images and videos immediately to test the platform's capabilities.

Items.Question: Can I turn text into video with What an AI?
Items.Answer: Absolutely. Our text-to-video feature allows you to type a simple prompt, and our AI will generate a dynamic video clip based on your description.

Items.Question: How do I convert an image to animation?
Items.Answer: Simply upload your photo to the image-to-video tool within What an AI. You can then choose motion settings to bring your static image to life.

Items.Question: Do I need a powerful computer to use this?
Items.Answer: No, What an AI is an online AI tool. All the processing happens in the cloud, so you can use it on any computer or mobile device with internet access.

Items.Question: Can I use the images for commercial purposes?
Items.Answer: Yes, our paid plans allow for commercial use. You can use the generated content for ads, websites, and products. Please check our pricing page for specific license details.

Items.Question: How long does it take to generate a video?
Items.Answer: It is very fast. Most short videos are generated in just a few minutes, making it an excellent tool for fast content production.

Items.Question: What makes What an AI different from other tools?
Items.Answer: We combine multiple top-tier AI models into one platform. Instead of paying for separate image and video tools, you get everything in one place with What an AI.

Items.Question: Can I edit the photos after generating them?
Items.Answer: Yes, we have a built-in AI editor. You can upscale, crop, remove backgrounds, and apply filters directly within the platform.

Items.Question: Is it good for social media content?
Items.Answer: It is perfect for it. You can create vertical videos (9:16) specifically for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
